name: conductor
description: Context-driven development framework for spec-driven development. Transforms AI CLI into a proactive project manager following: Context → Spec & Plan → Implement.

commands.name: setup
commands.description: Scaffolds the project and sets up the Conductor environment

commands.name: newTrack
commands.description: Plans a track, generates track-specific spec documents

commands.name: implement
commands.description: Executes the tasks defined in the specified track's plan

commands.name: status
commands.description: Displays the current progress of the project

commands.name: revert
commands.description: Reverts previous work using git-aware logic
